dogecoin.text:
ON DOGECOIN

I have no idea if the rise of $DOGE  is genuine or not.

But @elonmusk and his @nbcsnl skit could be the "Jamaican bobsled team" of 2021.

What does that mean?

Read this tale of a #dogecoin pump n' dump in 2014: https://t.co/uzJAhlh01R

Be careful.

#cryptocurrency https://t.co/E9sfKhp4Rx

Wouldn't be surprised to see a third #dogecoin push this year.

One that wipes out "sensible" people who so far held back and watched friends get rich.

The envy gets too strong.

All-in, because "i refuse to miss this one again"

And then...
